'''Archa Sabis's Droid Army''' was an uprising of [[EVS Construction Droid]]s, [[police speeder]]s and various other [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] after the mad [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Archa Sabis]] sent a computer virus into their systems, himself the victim of a computer virus that most likely instigated the army's creation. This [[Second Great Droid Revolution|rebellion]] of droids was unlike anything [[HK-01's droid army|seen]] since [[4015 BBY]].
